items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I did "I Worry About You" with Arthur Prysock... I played drums on his first New York recording

ctx.x: Now this Red Prysock -- what was his name?
Yeah, Red Prysock -- Prysock, the singer's, brother.
Yeah, what was his name, Al? One was Red Prysock.
